abilities._comment: Was a plain STATIC, which nothing dispatches -- the ability never ran. WHILE_STATIC is re-evaluated on every attack-power recalculation. SOURCE_IS_ATTACK confines it to this card's own attack.

_comment: "create an Inertia token under THEIR control" -- the hero that was hit. CREATE_TOKEN defaults to SELF, so this debuff landed on the ATTACKER: Inertia bottoms your hand and arsenal at end of turn, so the card punished the player who played it.
